title: Temporary Cloudflare accounts for AI agents
summary: Cloudflare announced temporary account functionality specifically designed for AI agents to interact with their infrastructure programmatically without requiring persistent human user accounts or OAuth flows.
problem_solved: Enables AI agents and autonomous systems to authenticate with Cloudflare services in a secure, time-limited manner without manual human intervention.
why_valuable: Addresses the growing need for machine-to-machine authentication patterns as AI agents become more prevalent in automating infrastructure management and API interactions.
